name: Code from Portuguese organisations on GitHub
owner: The organisations listed in sources/github-pt/orgs.json, through GitHub, Inc.'s REST API
gives: Public repositories and latest releases of Portuguese startups, companies, public bodies, universities and open-source projects on GitHub, each with its source URL, licence and the time read.

terms.summary: GitHub's terms allow this use: reading public data through the API is permitted; excessive requests may be suspended; data must not be used for spam or to sell users' personal information. We read organisations' public repositories and releases only, collect no personal data, stay well under the rate limits, and keep each repository's own licence (or a link to its terms) on every item. Not reviewed by a person.
